 (2) {#karman#}; (3) {#karaRa#}; (4) {#saMpradAna#}; (5) {#apAdAna#}; (6) {#aDikaraRa#}.
.²2 That part of grammar which treats of these relations; {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} syntax.
.²3 Water produced from hail.
